outcome: NDI or death at 2 years of age
cohort: The study included 548 extremely preterm infants (born less than 29 weeks) from January 2010 to December 2020, born to 496 pregnant people.
finding: Maternal extrauterine or intrauterine infection was not associated with neurodevelopmental impairment or death at 2 years of age in extremely preterm infants, but acute histologic chorioamnionitis was associated with this combined outcome.
